candidates.title: Prepare a safe workflow repair checklist

demandEvidence.chore: Get guidance on safely repairing an existing self-hosted workflow without unintended changes.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: We need guidance on safely repairing an existing workflow in self-hosted n8n 2.30.4 , without risking unintended changes.

ease.reason: A beginner can turn operator supplied workflow details into a review checklist, but the request gives no repair procedure or tool support.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: workflow consultants might charge for repair planning; this request establishes no buyer, payment, or repeat demand.

feasibility.reason: A four week test can draft a checklist from synthetic or operator supplied examples; version specific repair and useful accuracy remain untested.

autonomy.reason: The proposed tool can prepare a plan only; an operator must inspect the workflow and make and verify every change.

evidence.reason: The request explicitly asks for safe repair guidance, but gives no technical steps, frequency, or corroborating implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: Assessed the concrete request as a proposed checklist from operator supplied workflow details, symptom and intended change, tested on synthetic examples. No implementation evidence supports safe edits or version specific guidance; a human must verify and apply any change, so the mean is below 6.

steps.message: Assessed all four sealed discussion identities and added the omitted safe workflow repair request with five provisional ratings. Its proposed checklist is feasible to mock with synthetic or operator supplied inputs, but no reference supports repairs and the human must verify every change; the mean is below 6, so no post qualifies.
